page.title: SmartBnB: is this Airbnb a good deal?

footer.credits: Built by Adam Gruber, Axel Pittet and Edison Sahitaj.

evaluator.title: Is this Airbnb a good deal?
evaluator.lede: Paste a listing from canton Vaud. SmartBnB compares its nightly price, reviews and amenities with similar stays in the same area.
evaluator.example: Try it with a listing in Montreux
evaluator.noPrice: No recent price for this listing, so the price part of the score is neutral.
evaluator.howIntro: Each listing gets a score out of 100, built from four parts:
evaluator.howNote: Based on public InsideAirbnb data. Listings are compared with the same room type in the same neighbourhood.
evaluator.aiNote: Written by an AI model from this listing's numbers. It can make mistakes.

good.note: Better value than most comparable stays.

fair.note: In line with what the area offers.

poor.note: Similar stays nearby offer more for the money.

scoreError.400: That link doesn't look like an Airbnb listing. Paste the link shared from the Airbnb app, or one that contains /rooms/ followed by a number.
scoreError.404: This listing isn't in our data. SmartBnB only covers listings in canton Vaud that InsideAirbnb has recorded.
scoreError.422: We couldn't open this share link. Open it in your browser and copy the address from there: it should contain /rooms/ followed by a number.
scoreError.429: You've checked a lot of listings in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
scoreError.other: The check didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
